g.text: One control plane delegates every edit, test, Git action and cluster action to workers; humans hold the gates.

svg.text: DOES NOT: edit the repo; run
tests; mutate Git; act on the
live cluster. All of that is
a worker into its own reviewer.
need a human in SHADOW mode
RELAY AND CALLBACKS: an event is a trigger, NOT completion
model, no tokens). Watches ONE agent;
when it settled AND its report
or a local claim = NOT proof
LIGHTWEIGHT STATES (listed in source order; the documents give no transition table)
